svg.aria-label: The format-convert mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Phase 7 Formatter: LaTeX, DOCX through Pandoc, PDF or Markdown; journal formatting; citations between APA 7, Chicago, MLA, IEEE and Vancouver (agent); Hard gate: an unresolved citation-provenance marker in the input? (question); Output refused (stop); Final checklist: content, format, required elements; word count within 1 percent; compile errors fixed, warnings accepted (agent); Formatted document (agent) | paper, as built: Session asks: the targets, the format profile, the materials (stop); The target to settle, with the supported targets listed (stop); Script, run by the session: pandoc, a .md or a .docx to the .tex every target is converted from [5.Q (i)] (script); Phase 7 Formatter: citation style, venue template, format profile, as patches; the report [5.Q (i)] (ruled); Formatter, resumed: the conversion patch, when the citation style changes [5.Q (i)] (ruled, only when needed); Script, run by the session: the patches applied, latexmk for the PDF, pandoc for DOCX and Markdown [5.Q (i)] (script); Script, run by the session: the headings, figures, tables and abstract counted in each output [5.Q (i)] (script); A converted file to replace, when a converted output already stands (stop); Formatted document (agent); At every patch: a structural patch, a patch that does not apply, a script failed [5.Q (i)] (stop); The mode to run, for a plain request that fits two modes (stop).
